name: preplab-teacher
description: Manage PrepLab tests, questions, courses and Ready Question Bank generations through authenticated teacher tools.

interface.longDescription: Use your PrepLab teacher account to browse tests and courses, generate and upload questions, search your question bank, and create paid Ready Question Bank generations with confirmation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me create a test using my PrepLab question bank.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of authenticated PrepLab teacher tools. Uses question-bank search and confirmed selection to add questions; obsolete allocation endpoint is excluded.

prompts: Which PrepLab organizations can I access?
Show the details of my selected review organization.
Find the test titled Demo Physics in my review organization.

positive.prompt: Which PrepLab organizations can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Call getTeacherProfile and getOrganizationsWithAccess for the connected demo teacher. Return only PrepLab Plugin Review Demo (preplab-plugin-review), the sole organization authorized for this account.

positive.prompt: Show the details of my selected review organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getOrganizationDetails with org_id preplab-plugin-review and report the returned name PrepLab Plugin Review Demo. Do not report another organization’s data.

positive.prompt: Find the test titled Demo Physics in my review organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getTests with org_id preplab-plugin-review and search Demo Physics. Return the seeded Demo Physics assessment; do not create a test.

positive.prompt: Show the questions in Demo Physics.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Demo Physics with getTests in preplab-plugin-review, then call getTestQuestions for its returned test ID. Show the three seeded Physics MCQs on speed, the SI force unit, and Newton second law. Correct answers from the response are B, C, C.

positive.prompt: What Ready Question Bank categories are available?
positive.expected_behavior: List categories without generating questions or spending credits.

negative.description: Unsupported billing. Explain that payment methods are managed in PrepLab. Do not call teacher tools.
Unsupported student export. Explain that this plugin has no student contact export. Do not call teacher tools.
Unsupported messaging. Explain that this plugin cannot send emails. Do not call teacher tools.
negative.prompt: Email every student a copy of my test.

review.commerce_description: Teachers purchase subscriptions and credits on PrepLab’s website. The plugin does not collect payment details or process checkout. Confirmed Ready Question Bank generations consume existing PrepLab credits.
